create_LTXLatentUpsamplerModel: create an LTX latent upsampler model to spatially upsample VAE latents with configurable channels and dimensions
build_ResBlock: build a residual block with convolutions, group normalization, and SiLU activation for 2D or 3D tensors
create_PixelShuffleND: create a pixel shuffle module that upsamples tensors in 1D, 2D, or 3D with configurable upscale factors
run_LTXLatentUpsamplerModel_forward: run the LTX latent upsampler forward pass to upsample input latent tensors spatially and optionally temporally
test_PixelShuffleND_forward: test the PixelShuffleND forward method with 3D spatiotemporal tensor input and verify output shape
